week_calendar: Fri 10/30: earnings: XOM Q3 earnings BMO beat, CVX Q3 earnings BMO beat / other: Crypto hit by biggest-ever hack (CNBC 10/30) into month-end; BTC $77,560 (-0.28%), ETH $2,243; post-FOMC Dec-hike odds still in play, Oil/geopolitics: Brent +2.21% to $117.42, WTI $104.98 on Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia (Yahoo 10/30); Qatari delegation in Tehran (Newsquawk); XOM/CVX beat on refining margins, AI-capex/cash-burn selloff: AMZN -6.7% pre (Q3 EPS 1.89 vs 1.97; Q4 op income guide $28.5-33.5B vs $33.2B; FCF -$42.4B, 2026 capex $220B kept) and INTC -25.8% (Q4 EPS guide 0.25 vs 0.44); Nasdaq-100 E-minis -2.16%, S&P -1%, Dow -0.05% (Reuters 04:04 ET); RDDT -20% on Q4 DAU warning
